title: Paddleboard the Clear Waters of Rainbow Springs
includes: Beginner & Family Friendly Paddle Instruction & Safety Briefing
Small Group Guided Eco Tour for a more personal experience
Premium Paddle Boards or Paddle Board Kayak Hybrids
Complimentary Photo & Video Memories from Your Adventure
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

Equipment Selection Guests may choose between a stand-up paddle board or a paddle board kayak hybrid for their tour. After booking, please reply to your confirmation email or text us with your preferred vessel so we can prepare your equipment before arrival. If no preference is provided, equipment will be assigned based on availability at check-in.
Co-Rider Policy Children ages 4–12 may ride on the same paddleboard with a parent or guardian using our co-rider option. Maximum 2 riders per board with a combined weight limit of 350 lbs.
Pets are not permitted on the tour
Alcohol is not permitted during the experience
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Paddle boarding is the ultimate way to explore the crystal-clear waters of Rainbow Springs. Glide across vibrant turquoise spring water surrounded by lush tropical scenery that feels like a hidden paradise in Florida. Along the way, you can jump in for a refreshing swim, relax in the warm sunshine, and experience the springs from a peaceful perspective only paddle boarding offers. Our guided tours are designed to be fun, relaxing, and unforgettable, combining stunning scenery, wildlife, and a truly personal adventure on the water.

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

• Paddle over crystal-clear turquoise spring water
• Swim in Rainbow Springs during your adventure
• Spot wildlife like turtles, fish, birds, and river otters
• Explore the beautiful Indian Creek spring area
• Beginner & family friendly experience
• Small group guided adventure for a more personal experience
• Premium paddle boards and high-quality gear
